tools.name: sacs_search_districts
tools.description:
Search current public California districts by name, 7-digit LEA, or 14-digit CDS.

        Omit query or pass an empty string to browse all current districts.
        Follow page.next_offset while page.has_more is true; pages contain at most 50 rows.

tools.name: sacs_list_public_datasets
tools.description: List versioned official public SACS datasets for one district.

tools.name: sacs_query_attendance
tools.description: Return recovered Form A ADA observations for one official district filing.

tools.name: sacs_query_financial_summary
tools.description: Return bounded aggregate financial summaries for one explicit official dataset.

tools.name: sacs_compare_districts
tools.description: Compare deterministic object-category totals for two explicit official datasets.

tools.name: sacs_district_context_pack
tools.description: Build fiscal-distress rows with source filing details. Deficit spending is signed net operating result / expenditure; negative means deficit.

tools.name: sacs_district_context_pack_batch
tools.description: Build bounded district packs with source filing details. Deficit spending is signed net operating result / expenditure; negative means deficit.

tools.name: sacs_explain_code
tools.description: Explain current public fund, resource, goal, function, or object codes.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "sacs_get_csam_related" is 785 chars, far longer than this server's median (142). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sacs_register_client" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
